lessons.titleEn: I Want to Go to Taiwan
objectives: Explain the reason for a job change.
Explain the circumstances for a job change.
Describe your future [life] plans.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about a job or life change and the reason for it (的話, 除了……還 / 也……).
Write a paragraph about what you hope to do in a new place besides working (除了……還 / 也……).
Write a paragraph about what you would ask a friend to do for you (請你把……V一V), and what you will do if something happens (……的話).

objectives: Talk about how an air flight went.
Describe locations and facilities at an airport.
Grasp the traffic situation near an airport.
Express gratitude and concern.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about a long trip: how tired, hungry or busy you were (……得不得了, 一點都不……).
Write the steps of how you get from an airport to your hotel or home (先……再……, 往……).
Write a paragraph about the traffic and transport near an airport you know (往, 先……再……, ……得不得了).

lessons.titleEn: I Have Rented a Pretty Nice Apartment
objectives: State your residential needs.
Describe the surroundings of your residence.
State the circumstances of renting a place to live.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about the home you want to rent and what you need (另外, 算是).
journalPrompts.promptZh: 我想租一間安靜的公寓。

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph comparing two places to live: price, noise, distance (算是 / 不算, 再加上).
Write a paragraph about what you will do after you move, step by step (等……再……, 另外).

lessons.titleEn: The MRT is Fast and Convenient
objectives: Describe means of transportation used in daily life.
Explain the pros and cons of different means of transportation.
Describe what it is like to take [various] means of transport.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about how you go to work or school and why you chose it (才, 難怪).
Write a paragraph about the good and bad points of two means of transport (難怪, 才).
Write a paragraph about something you can freely choose, using a question word twice (想……什麼就……什麼).

lessons.titleEn: The Night Market is Really Bustling
objectives: Express how much you like something to which you look forward.
Explain why night markets are popular.
Describe the taste and characteristics of foods.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about a food you tried or want to try at a night market (早就……了, 會……的).
Write a paragraph about why night markets are popular and what they mean to you or to tourists (對……來說, 不管……都……).
Describe the taste and look of a food with doubled words such as 熱熱的、酥酥脆脆的 (VsVs的).

objectives: Describe city scenes.
Compare differences among cities.
Talk about city life.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about how long you have been somewhere and what you are doing now (……了……了, V著).
journalPrompts.promptZh: 我在這裡住了三個月了。

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about what a city is connected to: history, religion, weather (跟……有關係).
Write a paragraph comparing two cities (跟……比起來) and say how long something took you (……才……).

lessons.titleZh: 臺灣人喜歡的休閒活動
lessons.titleEn: Favorite Leisure Activities of Taiwanese People
objectives: Expound on leisure activities that people like.
Explain why leisure activities are popular.
Describe your feelings while taking part in leisure activities.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about something you never did before (從來沒……) and how your interest changed (本來……，後來……).
Write a paragraph about what makes a leisure activity enjoyable if one condition is met (只要……就……).
Write a paragraph about watching a game with friends: who won or lost, and how the fans differ in their habits (在……上, 只要……就……).

objectives: Elucidate Chinese marriage customs.
Describe a wedding ceremony.
Learn about Chinese gift-giving taboos.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about a custom or celebration you know and when it starts (從……起 / 開始, 尤其).
journalPrompts.promptZh: 從古代起，華人就很重視這個典禮。

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about what people care about at a wedding, using 連……都 / 也 for emphasis.
Write a paragraph about something you can or cannot recognise or work out (V得 / 不出來).

objectives: Give an overview of Taiwan’s Indigenous Peoples.
Describe some cultural characteristics of Taiwan’s Indigenous Peoples.
Talk about cultural events, objects or practices you find interesting.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about the places you want to visit and list them (A、B、C 等).
journalPrompts.promptZh: 我想去阿里山、日月潭、墾丁等地方。

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about how two groups or people do things differently (各V各的).
Write a paragraph about something you absolutely must do on a trip (非……不可).

lessons.topic: Experience with living in another country
objectives: Talk about living in a foreign country.
Explain an unforgettable life experience.
Describe how you feel about something.

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about how living abroad brought you something (給……帶來……).
journalPrompts.promptZh: 學中文給我帶來更多機會。

journalPrompts.promptEn: Write a paragraph about packing and souvenirs: what fits and what does not (V得 / 不下).
Write a paragraph about how things usually are in a place you know (一般來說).

grammarItems.pattern: (如果 / 要是) + clause + 的話，……
grammarItems.explanationEn: 的話 at the end of a clause means 'if …': 你有空的話，我們去吃飯. It can be used alone or together with 如果 / 要是 at the start; leaving out 如果 sounds more casual.

grammarItems.pattern: 除了 + A，還 / 也 + B
grammarItems.explanationEn: 除了…還/也… means 'besides A, also B': 哥哥除了喜歡潛水，還喜歡爬山. It adds to what the listener already knows rather than replacing it.

grammarItems.pattern: 請 + 你 + 把 + O + V (一) V
grammarItems.explanationEn: A doubled verb after 把 makes a polite request or suggestion: 請你把房間整理整理, 把這件衣服洗(一)洗. With a two-syllable verb repeat the whole verb (整理整理).
grammarItems.matcher: 把.+(洗一洗|看一看|試一試|想一想|整理整理|檢查檢查|看看|洗洗|想想|整理整理|聽聽|問問|擦擦|寫寫|做做|收拾收拾|烤一烤|打掃打掃)

grammarItems.pattern: S + Vs + 得 + 不得了
grammarItems.explanationEn: 不得了 after Vs+得 means 'extremely' with a slight exaggeration: 夏天的天氣熱得不得了, 他高興得不得了.
先…再… orders two actions: first one, then the other. It is the book 4 version of 先…然後…, and you can combine them: 先…然後再….

grammarItems.pattern: S + 一點 + (O) + 都 / 也 + 不 / 沒 + V
grammarItems.explanationEn: 一點都不 / 一點也沒 is a strong 'not at all': 我一點都不餓, 他一點也沒生氣. An object goes after 一點 and before 都 or 也.
往 points in a direction of travel: 往前走, 往右轉. 從 names the starting point and can be left out when it is obvious.
grammarItems.matcher: 往[前後左右東西南北上下]

grammarItems.explanationEn: 另外 introduces an additional point or action, roughly 'in addition, besides that': 我訂好了旅館，另外也租好了車.

grammarItems.pattern: A + 算是 + B ；A + 不算 + B
grammarItems.explanationEn: 算是 gives a judgement that something 'counts as' or 'can be considered' something: 這家旅館算是便宜的. The negative is 不算.
再加上 piles one more factor on top, usually the decisive one: 位置好，再加上價錢便宜，所以很多人住這裡.
等…再… means 'wait until A is done, then B': 等朋友都來了，我們再開始. The second action waits for the first.

才 in the second clause says the result happens only when the first clause is true: 要有悠遊卡，才能坐捷運 (you can ride the MRT only with an EasyCard). The first clause is the condition; 才 comes after the subject of the second.
難怪 marks 'no wonder': once you learn the reason, a result makes sense. 他在臺灣住了十年，難怪華語說得這麼好.

grammarItems.pattern: S + 想 / 要 + V + 什麼 / 哪裡 / 誰 …，就 + V + 什麼 / 哪裡 / 誰
grammarItems.explanationEn: A question word used twice in a row means 'whatever / wherever / whoever': 你想吃什麼就吃什麼. Both appearances refer to the same thing, and the answer is up to the person.
grammarItems.matcher: (什麼|哪裡|哪兒|誰|哪個|哪一個|怎麼|幾).*(什麼|哪裡|哪兒|誰|哪個|哪一個|怎麼|幾)

grammarItems.explanationEn: 早就…了 says something happened long ago, earlier than expected: 公寓我們早就租好了. 早就 comes before the verb and 了 closes the sentence.
會…的 gives an assurance about the future: 放心，一定會很好的. 的 at the end softens it into a reassuring statement.
對…來說 means 'for …, from … point of view': 對學生來說，夜市很有意思.
不管…都… means 'no matter …, still …': 不管天氣怎麼樣，我都去. The first part is a question word or an A-not-A choice.
A doubled state verb plus 的 before a noun makes the description warmer and more vivid: 熱熱的茶, 甜甜的蛋糕, 小小的房間.

grammarItems.pattern: S + (已經) + V + 了 + length of time + 了
grammarItems.explanationEn: Two 了 around a time length mean the action has gone on for that long and is STILL going: 我在臺灣住了兩個月了 (and I'm still here). With one 了 it is over.

grammarItems.pattern: A + 跟 + B + (沒) 有關係
grammarItems.explanationEn: 跟…有關係 says A is connected to B, and B influences A. The negative is 跟…沒有關係; in writing, 有關 alone also works (跟天氣有關).
著 after a verb shows a continuing state (門開著) and, before another verb, the way or situation in which the action happens: 站著等車, 聽著音樂做飯.
grammarItems.matcher: [坐站躺看聽拿穿帶開關掛排]著

grammarItems.pattern: A + 跟 + B + 比起來，……
grammarItems.explanationEn: 跟…比起來 compares two things and then gives the result: 跟臺北比起來，臺中安靜多了. The comparison may favour either A or B.

grammarItems.pattern: S + V + 了 + length of time + 才 + V
grammarItems.explanationEn: 才 after a time length says it took long or happened late: 我等了半個小時才上車. With 就 instead (一個小時就到了) the same time feels short.
grammarItems.matcher: [年月天週鐘頭小時分久]才|才[^，。？！]*了

grammarItems.pattern: S + 從來 + 沒 / 不 + V
grammarItems.explanationEn: 從來沒/不 means 'never': 他從來沒喝過酒 (never has), 我從來不吃肉 (never do). 從來沒 pairs with 過.
本來…後來/現在… contrasts the original situation with what changed: 本來我不喜歡跑步，後來愛上了.
只要…就… means 'as long as …, then …': 只要有手機，就不會迷路. The condition is easy to meet.
在…上 narrows the claim to one aspect: 在生活上, 在價錢上, 在個性上 mean 'as far as life / price / character is concerned'. The noun is abstract.
grammarItems.matcher: (生活|價錢|個性|習慣|文化|品質|工作|學習|健康)上

grammarItems.pattern: 從 + time + 起 / 開始
grammarItems.explanationEn: 從…起/開始 gives the starting point of something: 從下個月起, 從小就. 起 is written; 開始 is the everyday form.
尤其(是) picks out what stands out among several things: 夜市小吃很受歡迎，尤其是炸雞排.
連…都/也… means 'even …': 他連中文都不會說. X is the surprising extreme.
出來 after a verb means you manage to pick out or work something out: 看得出來 (can tell), 聽不出來 (can't make out), 想出來.
grammarItems.matcher: [看聽想猜認說做找吃][得不]出來|[看聽想猜認說做找吃]出來

grammarItems.explanationEn: 各V各的 means everyone does their own thing: 我們各付各的 (we each pay for our own), 各有各的味道 (each has its own flavour).
等 at the end of a list means 'and so on': 像雞排、臭豆腐、小籠包等. It signals there are more items without naming them.

grammarItems.pattern: S + 非 + V / VP + 不可
grammarItems.explanationEn: 非…不可 stresses that something absolutely must be done: 你非去不可 (you have to go). It is stronger than 一定要.

grammarItems.pattern: S + 給 + someone + 帶來 + N
grammarItems.explanationEn: 給…帶來… means 'bring … to …': 學華語給我帶來更多機會. Use it for results or benefits that something causes.
得下/不下 says whether there is room or capacity for something: 坐得下十個人 (seats ten), 吃不下了 (can't eat more).
一般來說 introduces a general rule or the usual situation: 一般來說，臺灣的夏天很熱.
